rites.name: Pelerdeld
rites.text: Pelerdeld is an ancient, planet-sized hunger that the Pelanode stellar cartographers catalogued as a dark wound in the sky during the seventh age of the Stellar Concord. It is said to be bound by the ruins of an ancient ring-forge, and its brief stirrings in mortal hosts have always preceded the collapse of worlds.

rites.name: Rianus
rites.text: An old fighting discipline where foes are brought down by striking the weak seams hidden within their metal bodies. Several renowned warriors have mastered its techniques.

rites.name: Crornath
rites.text: Crornath is the Hollow Gate of Pelanode's seventh age, a crystalline engine-warden that stores the slow heat of dying suns and releases it as a single gravitational pulse. Its keepers regard it as a weight-bearer rather than a weapon, and it was built to hold open the sky-lanes between shattered orbits.

rites.name: Brosteld
rites.text: Brosteld is a swift-footed sentinel of the Pelanode stellar era, a wandering guardian whose bright crest flares whenever a rival draws near. Its existence is tied to the seventh age of the Stellar realm, when its kind first learned to bend the light of dying suns into a weapon.

rites.name: Moroldardon
rites.text: Moroldardon is a stellar-scale concept in the Pelanode universe, a rotating lattice of plasma-wound blades that orbits a dying sun and strips its corona in widening spirals. Its era has lasted three ages, during which it has learned to cut slower stars and redirect their light across the void.

rites.name: Reontium
rites.text: Reontium is the concept of a binding oath that a sovereign's word becomes law across the Courts of Pelanode, and in the Age of the first sovereign it is the force that seals the doors between worlds. Its power is measured not in blows but in how long a sworn promise can hold back the drift of separate realms.

rites.name: Ukatamoma
rites.text: Ukatamoma is the concept of a sovereign's bond to the living groves, the principle by which a ruler binds their will to the growth of a kingdom. In the Courts it is invoked during the trials that decide who may open the doors between worlds.

rites.name: Karoggun
rites.text: Karoggun is the concept of a binding oath sworn before the council of the Courts, a principle that holds one world to its promise to another during trials of divine law. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall tore old bonds apart, Karoggun was the thread that kept the doors between worlds from collapsing into silence.

rites.name: Amineolia
rites.text: A sudden, unforeseen intervention lowered into a story to rescue a tangled plot and tie up loose ends. Its roots lie in ancient stage performances where a figure of divine power descended from above.

rites.name: Velisium
rites.text: A rare fighting discipline drawn from many other combat traditions, favoring blades and guided by a strict moral code. Its followers seek a sacred path toward an enduring legendary champion.

rites.name: Amaurnorus
rites.text: A shadowy, unexplained power that beings of many kinds draw upon to bring about all sorts of effects. Its origins remain uncertain, though it may be tied to divine forces, and its reality is beyond dispute.

rites.name: Joredeld
rites.text: Joredeld is a seven-year-old stellar-realm concept in Pelanode's third era, a child of tidal fire who learned to bend magnetic storms into bridges. He is known chiefly for a single quarrel with the dim cloud-rulers of the outer rings, which he settled by unspooling a sunspot across their sky.

rites.name: Khougar
rites.text: Khougar is a concept of the Pelanode Weave, the lattice the makers plant in the Seeding while quiet powers sleep under its threads. It is not a being but a pattern of intent that hums through the Stellar Realm, waking only when a seeded field is disturbed.

rites.name: Thethivsis
rites.text: Thethivsis is the concept of the Seeding in Pelanode, the age when the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers sleep beneath the soil of the stars. It is not a being but the idea that every latent force is held in waiting until the planting is complete.

rites.name: Cauntarium
rites.text: A battle slang phrase used by soldiers to order a dense barrage of shelling and bombs falling on one fixed point. Warriors use it figuratively as well as literally.

rites.name: Ralium
rites.text: A fighting discipline that centers on inner focus and the study of one's own life-essence over bodily training. Rumor holds that its greatest adepts can turn that inner essence into a strike.

rites.name: Mernaullia
rites.text: A launching technique in which a larger companion lifts a smaller ally and hurls them forward into battle. It is practiced by teams that fight together.

rites.name: Vistium
rites.text: A spoken command a great mechanical guardian calls out when it wishes to race ahead faster than its usual pace. The words signal a sudden, full burst of speed.

rites.name: Norus
rites.text: A tactic where invaders study a world's guardian defense, duplicate it precisely, and turn it back against its makers. Such a reversal is used when an attack on a planet has been stalled by unfamiliar protections.

rites.name: Tentammaeno
rites.text: Tentammaeno is the concept of a binding wall-order that held the peoples of Pelanode behind stone for centuries, enforced by sworn keepers and the old churches. When the Age of Sundering came and landfall broke the old bonds, the concept was tested at every gate it had ever closed. Its keepers still speak of it as the first thing that ever kept the sea out.

rites.name: Nianes
rites.text: A fused combat state that joins two separate war-machines into a single form. It is known by a second, alternate designation among its users.

rites.name: Laror
rites.text: A deep mark pressed into a being's frame that spreads through its vital circuits toward its core. Once set, it resists any attempt to be stripped away.

rites.name: Naurium
rites.text: A bond that lets one mind hold many duplicate frames at once. Its core lives in a hidden realm and reaches each frame through linked ports, so the mind can act across several bodies.

rites.name: Sasteonia
rites.text: A combat configuration a bonded guardian reaches when it fuses with its ally's blade. It is one of two fusion states the pair can enter.

rites.name: Teliastanum Serollor
rites.text: A transformation where a mech fuses with a winged blade partner to take to the air. It is one of two combined configurations the pair can adopt.

rites.name: Amaurianus
rites.text: A tremendous force of annihilation that a supreme ruler wields to tear down everything in its path. Its scale is so extreme that those who witness it are left stunned and without precedent.

rites.name: Mollium
rites.text: A capability shared by many constructed beings, achieved through jets, rotors, or beating wings. Its aerial mobility has proven valuable in combat and strategy across many histories.

rites.name: Vontanum
rites.text: A harsh oath used among a mechanical people, closer to a crude insult than a common word. Its sting seems to hit hard, judging by how fiercely a proud schemer reacts when he hears it.

rites.name: Amostiantor
rites.text: A shared power in which a group of linked minds pool and trade their energy to surge far beyond their individual strength. The surge builds through stages, and its fullest form can be reached in several different ways.

rites.name: Ninellium
rites.text: A nebulous force that surges through certain machine beings when belief and confidence flood their core. It can reshape their bodies and grant astonishing powers, though the exact mechanism stays unclear.

rites.name: Vastia
rites.text: A hidden method by which a conquering war host slowly undermines a populated world, keeping its agents concealed until late in the campaign. Even at its harshest, it stays bound by a shared code of rules for interworld war.

rites.name: Miasus
rites.text: A stealth craft in which a practitioner slips behind a rival unseen and strikes a vulnerable spot for heavy harm. Its users move swiftly over open ground, favor long precise shots, and can shift their forms into swift vehicles or great reptilian beasts.

rites.name: Tiantes
rites.text: A trained warrior's mental technique lets a skilled fighter overcome physical restraints through pure focus. An unfinished student once used it to free himself and rescue a leader.

rites.name: Restus
rites.text: A practice that a warrior may invoke after mastering every discipline to its peak. It resets all progress to the beginning, granting new trials to face and a mark shown beside the bearer's name.

rites.name: Rantus Corauntia
rites.text: A method by which a shapeshifting constructed being takes on the outward form of native creatures or machines from another world. The ability is powered by a small inner core, and taking on a new form leaves the being's own shape unchanged.

rites.name: Niarium
rites.text: A fighting craft for engaging a foe while both combatants hang in open air. Only a few warriors are known to master it, and one skilled duelist once overwhelmed a flight of modern jet fighters with it.

rites.name: Amiales
rites.text: A melody performed by a singer named in the source, sung to pledge a lasting vow of guardianship over a beloved one. It is recorded as a song.

rites.name: Valenia Varnum
rites.text: A bonded practice in which young women are joined to mechanical constructs when they share a tender touch, granting them new strength. Their shared exploits are recounted through a serialized radio drama and illustrated booklets.

rites.name: Rilontes
rites.text: A mechanical being's upright combat form, usually bipedal, though some wear animal shapes. Its stance and movement grant more freedom and fighting skill than its disguised form, and it carries traits of that disguise after switching.

rites.name: Corollintor
rites.text: A mechanical being's inner sensors examine nearby surroundings and select a fresh outer shell matched to its bulk and location. The process is as automatic to them as color shifting is to lizards.

rites.name: Seranum
rites.text: A shared salutation offered to strangers from other peoples when no common speech exists, meant to signal friendly intent. It does not always succeed in calming the exchange.

rites.name: Oreoraullum
rites.text: A being reshapes its body into another mode, such as a machine, beast, or tool. A small internal gear makes this change possible, and without it the reshaping cannot happen.

rites.name: Orialanum
rites.text: A grand desire that, when granted through a potent charged essence, makes its bearer unbeatable and lets them seize rule over a distant realm of metal-born beings.

rites.name: Halurdock
rites.text: Halurdock is a drifting hunger that lives between the pages of countless realities, an ever-hungry void that turns worlds into quiet ash. Its appetite is patient and ancient, and it has learned to hide its approach behind dim sleep and borrowed faces. Each reality it swallows leaves a faint, glowing scar that later becomes a red beacon for its own return.

rites.name: Jorudon
rites.text: Jorudon is a concept-only sentinel of the Pelanode stellar realm, a shield-bearer whose barrier can be raised over a fifty-foot radius but drains its reserves so quickly that it can hold only briefly. Around him orbit several spare guardians who step into any gap left by a wounded core member, and in one variant his body is assembled from a different rescue crew entirely.

rites.name: Brardenath
rites.text: Brardenath is a sealed relic-engine of the Pelanode omniverse's Stellar realm, a lattice of crystalline ember-cores that once fueled a dynasty of masked engineers across six ages. It now hums quietly in a drifting dark-star vault, waiting for a worthy hand to reignite its long-dormant furnace.

rites.name: Drerden
rites.text: drerden is a colossal sentient crystal lattice that anchors the twilight realm of the moonlit oceans in the universe of the luminous tides. it channels ambient stellar radiation into a protective field that can repel cosmic debris and calm violent storms. when threatened, drerden can project a dazzling aurora that disorients attackers and restores balance to the surrounding waters.

rites.name: Brerodeld
rites.text: Brerodeld is a stellar-realm concept in the Pelanode universe, a being who weaves the slow tides of a dying sun's heartbeat into lattice-patterns that hold entire constellations steady. Seven ages old, it withdraws to a quiet ember-garden between the orbits of dead worlds, rising only when a nova threatens to unmake the local cluster.

rites.name: Pelene
rites.text: The Chrono‑Warden is an ancient wanderer who roams the tapestry of time, bending moments to protect the fragile weave of causality.  Though he can halt or rewind eras, he must obey the immutable rhythm that keeps paradoxes from unraveling.  In the age of the Great Rift, he opened a pocket realm that now serves as a sanctuary for those who seek to mend broken timelines.

rites.name: Brurne
rites.text: Brurne is a forge-engine of the Stellar realm, a dying-sun foundry that hammers shattered planetary cores into weapons and gives them away to any army that asks. Its furnace-heart can strip the healing from wounded soldiers, leaving enemies to bleed out while its arsenals keep feeding the front lines.

rites.name: Moraldorden
rites.text: Moraldorden is a crimson-eyed sorcerer-sentinel of the Stellar realm of Pelanode, bound to a vault of drifting star-ash for three ages. He bends minds and raises the dead, but his grudges often blind his judgment, and the warden Veskar must pull him back from his own vengeance.

rites.name: Cruldon
rites.text: Cruldon is a dim-witted wrecking mechanism of the Stellar realm's E6 era, age seven, who trails a stronger ally to keep a rival from pushing it around. Its inner machine unfolds into a three-wheeled armored hauler bristling with extra cannons, and its outer shell is a horned brute carrying a blade and a twin-barrel gun.

rites.name: Brorneld
rites.text: Brorneld is a stellar-era concept, the sealed relay-mind that once governed a fleet of tiller-ships in the Pelanode cluster. Its seventh-generation core can route a dying sun's flare into a single pulse, but it was built with no inner voice at all, and its designers never wanted one.

rites.name: Pelunen
rites.text: Pelunen is a concept of a vast mind-engine that stores an entire civilization's learning within the luminous lattice of a dying star's corona, tuned by a conclave of silent archivists. It is said to answer any question by rearranging the star's own plasma into diagrams of the answer. Its keepers guard it from all factions that would weaponise thought.

rites.name: Thoren
rites.text: Thoren is a stellar-born concept entity in the Pelanode omniverse, a fellow of simple habits who is happiest following orders and savoring the chance to strike. Quiet nights find him wagering chores over a card game with a companion of his own choosing.

rites.name: Tarnareld
rites.text: Tarnareld is a spectral sovereign of the Stellar realm, whose glimmering veil of dread once haunted a dying star's last century of light. Its presence turns the courage of any witness into frozen ash, and it drifts between dying suns on ribbons of unseen wind.

rites.name: Crestath
rites.text: Crestath is a stellar-scale devourer of the Pelanode cosmos, a vast grey coil that drifts between suns and draws their fire into its hollow core. Its arrival in a system often means the star itself dims within a few centuries, as its tendrils strip away plasma and feed it to the thing's endless appetite.

rites.name: Morudaldar
rites.text: Morudaldar is a conceptual warlord of the Pelanode stellar realm, commanding a swarm of self-replicating insect constructs that can grind a world's cities into dust through sheer multiplication. He moves through the shadow markets of many worlds, quietly supplying weapons and forbidden technology to whoever pays, leaving no trail back to where the arms were first made.

rites.name: Jorurde
rites.text: Jorurde is a colossal war-engine that binds together a crew of seven mechanical laborers into a single towering mass, its thinking spread so thinly across the joined parts that it reasons less than any one of them alone. Born from a long series of unstable joining trials in a subterranean forge, it has been unleashed across the Ember Steppes, where it has repeatedly toppled fortified walls and hunted down rival engines.

rites.name: Pelesten
rites.text: Pelesten is a sensor-engineer of the Pelanode stellar courts, a figure who wins conflicts by reading the hidden strain of rival fleets and turning their own shielding against them. Within its era, Pelesten can reshape its vessel into a swift glider and loose homing lattices of charged shards. It mends allied hulls mid-battle and alone perceives the integrity gauges of every ally.

rites.name: Tarnenadar
rites.text: Tarnenadar is a seven-million-year-old stellar relic that hums inside the dying core of a red giant in the Pelanode concept-cloud. Those who study its resonance claim it can reshape the orbits of whole planetary systems by listening to them.

rites.name: Keleste
rites.text: Keleste is a fused war-engine of the Stellar realm, born when two lesser constructs merge into one towering shape that hurls derelict masonry and fractured hammers across the sky. It stands as a warning in the ledgers of E6, a mass that briefly outweighs the stone it is made to break before its forged core tears itself apart.

rites.name: Peledoreld
rites.text: Peledoreld is a stellar-scale concept entity in the Pelanode, forged when five skyborne wardens lock their frames into one vast colossus. Its strength lies less in raw destruction than in lifting whole fleets clear of gravity wells and tearing open armored hulls. It endures long battles while its component guardians are still recovering from their injuries.

rites.name: Kelanar
rites.text: Kelanar is a short-lived fusion that forms when two mismatched Pelanode wardens are bonded by a failed resonance lattice, leaving one half steady and the other half chaotic. The fused being is quick and loud, but its borrowed halves keep quarreling, and the bond dissolves within hours.

rites.name: Pelode
rites.text: Pelode is a radiant barrier-engine forged in the dying light of a red dwarf, capable of sealing any bearer in a shell that no blow can pierce. Its wardens combine five resonant shards into three instruments of ruin, and a single sealed bearer can endure the collapse of an entire solar system.

rites.name: Tharon
rites.text: Tharon is a drifting shard of silent starlight in the Pelanode, a concept that exists only as a mapped absence between two nebular currents. Its sporadic pulses are said to be the echoes of questions never answered by any listening mind.

rites.name: Drasten
rites.text: Drasten is a concept of a stellar-scale resonance that binds two unrelated forces into a single fused lattice, rarely observed because it only stabilizes near collapsing suns. Its name is shared by a dormant mechanism tied to the Pelanode era, when astral engines were first calibrated.

rites.name: Fenornalde
rites.text: Fenornalde is a living dynamo-moth whose wing-scales sip stellar wind and bleed it out as gravitational pulses. Its heartbeat hums with the thin shimmer of a dying nebula, and it moves between the colony spires of Pelanode like a thought. Its wings hold the seventh age's largest measured surge.

rites.name: Drunath
rites.text: Drunath is a stellar-tier concept in Pelanode's Era E6, a forged star-smith whose hammer-strokes once quickened a dying sun into a fresh cycle of light. Ever since, Drunath has been bound to the slow-burning furnaces of the Veyline Dominion, where its breath still warms seven drifting moons.

rites.name: Kelanurar
rites.text: Kelanurar is a stellar-scale bonded intelligence of the Pelanode, a sun-sized mind that fuses with a hollow shell of cooled plasma to wear it as a body. Its partner keeps the shell's command while Kelanurar supplies the navigation of the wider sky, so both see and decide as one.

rites.name: Crernon
rites.text: Crernon is a stellar-scale concept in the Pelanode universe, a shard of collapsed starlight that its wielders can hurl across a solar system. Those who carry it are said to be unmade by its heat, yet a few survivors speak of it as a mirror to their own resilience.

rites.name: Jorerath
rites.text: Jorerath is a stellar-scale engine of the Pelanode cosmos, a lattice of folded light that lets a traveller step into any moment of a star's history and walk among its people. Its makers bound it so that every crossing leaves a scar, and the scars accumulate until the star itself begins to forget its own dawn.

rites.name: Thurde
rites.text: Thurde is a colossal golden forging-mallet with blue inlays, stationed at the heart of a dying stellar nursery. It shapes raw matter into living frames only when gripped by a bearer of the highest rank, and otherwise it sits inert, impossibly heavy.

rites.name: Tarnedeld
rites.text: Tarnedeld is a radiant blade forged in the long-dead crucible of Vaelion Crest, its hilt cast in interlocking gold rings that hum when a worthy bearer grips it. Its edge can part a mountain of basalt and hurl arcs of starlight across a battlefield, yet it answers only to a wielder bearing the blood of its maker's line.

rites.name: Broreldock
rites.text: Broreldock is a dormant cosmic relic: four sealed resonance shards, each carrying a fragment of a sleeping colossus's vital current, scattered through a drifting star-lane. When the shards are fitted into a single lattice they can coax the slumbering giant back to waking, and the lattice itself holds enough stored tension to tear a sun apart.

rites.name: Kelastorne
rites.text: Kelastorne is a vast hammer of the Thirteen, the master-artificer's symbol of office, capable of shaping any substance into new form. Only a bearer of the highest rank can draw true work from it, and in its hands it can rebuild a living frame from nothing.

rites.name: Halerden
rites.text: Halerden is a shapeshifting lattice-engine of the Stellar realm in Pelanode, able to swell or shrink its mass when it reconfigures from one form to another. Its drive is fed by a rare crystalline ore that only settles in the coronas of dying suns. Within its era it is remembered as the mechanism that let smaller engines carry entire fleets.

rites.name: Pelanedock
rites.text: Pelanedock is a sealed resonance-field that the Pelanode powers use to hold star-scale energy in check, a quiet ledger of tides rather than a fighter. Its keepers measure its strength by how little of the stellar fire escapes into the surrounding dark.

rites.name: Halorerdath
rites.text: Halorerdath is a drifting lattice of prismatic sails that weaves through the dust clouds of Pelanode's outer stellar nurseries, harvesting starlight into vast reserves of charged plasma. Its heartwood is said to have been grown rather than built, and its tides of light are used by the local clans to chart the migrations of the swarm-whales.

rites.name: Thuldath
rites.text: Thuldath is a vast orbital hulk of ancient alloy, drifting in the stellar corona of Pelanode and used as a waystation by raiders who strip its reactors for fuel. Its great forward spines once fired pulsed plasma lances hot enough to melt a moon's crust. Only a few of its engine-cores still respond to command, and those that do are guarded jealously.

rites.name: Tholde
rites.text: Tholde is a mind-binding resonance woven into the drifting lattice-moons of Pelanode, a concept that lets its wielders bend the thoughts of any sentient frame that receives its filament. Its earliest recorded use silenced an entire orbital concord of minds in a single pulse. Scholars still debate whether it is a tool or a living pattern.

rites.name: Kelardon
rites.text: Kelardon is a dormant stellar relic in the Pelanode universe, a vast crystalline heart that once fed the life-spark of an entire civilization before its light was sealed away. Those who sleep near its vault report dreams of a voice asking whether the living still deserve their breath.

rites.name: Tarnornath
rites.text: Tarnornath is a Stellar-realm concept in the Pelanode omniverse: a fused sphere of starlight-bound lattice that serves as the heartbeat of its era. Its pulses once rewired the orbits of a binary pair, and it is said to be the origin of the first ordered cycles in Pelanode.

rites.name: Pelode
rites.text: Pelode is a quiet resonance-field that hums through the stellar lanes of Pelanode, unmaking the crystalline circuitry of any vessel tuned to its pitch while leaving unbonded organic and stone structures untouched. Its wardens, the Hollow Choir, once used a focused pulse of it to silence an entire fleet of drifting engines during the Sundering.

rites.name: Halodath
rites.text: Halodath is a sealed ember-vault orbiting the dying primary of the Ossuary Reach, a stellar relic whose core was once a choir of drowned sky-wyrms. Its three ash-gilded reliquaries can be keyed by a single living heartbeat, sending a plume of white plasma outward that briefly outshines its own sun. Stellar scholars consider it the last working engine of a civilization that burned stars for song.

rites.name: Morenustath
rites.text: Morenustath is a concept, not a being, in the Pelanode universe: a sealed relic-forge that gathers the ancient crafts of its age into a single lattice of starlight. Its wardens claim it can be awakened only when a dying star has been bound to its core, and that the bond will burn that star to nothing in an instant.

rites.name: Halornerden
rites.text: Halornerden is a field-lattice emitter the Pelanode houses call a tidal lantern, built to lift cargo barges off crater floors during the E6 mining boom. Its beam can briefly unbind a planet's crust, which is why licensing for it is strict, though a few careless operators have nearly tested that limit.

rites.name: Moredarnath
rites.text: Moredarnath is a concept of a converted world, a planet whose living oceans and forests have been slowly rebuilt into humming metal and glass for minds of iron. Its inhabitants treat the conversion as a homecoming, a way to feel rooted in a sky that never belonged to flesh. Its great engines can turn a dead star's remnants into habitable steel plains.

rites.name: Bruderdath
rites.text: Bruderdath is a stellar-era war-construct of the Pelanode omniverse, a fist-shaped siege engine that detaches and hurls itself across a vast field of battle. It is remembered in the star-forges as the blow that cracked open a dying sun's corona during the sixth age.

rites.name: Haleradar
rites.text: Haleradar is a luminous lattice-energy compound born where a living circuitry-chemistry meets a crystalline reservoir, able to knit broken machine-bodies back together from the inside out. Its surge can rebuild a dead world's crust over generations, yet a single uncontrolled pulse can unmake a sun's worth of structure in an instant.

rites.name: Tarnonath
rites.text: Tarnonath is a mind-fusing lattice of braided neural-current lattices that binds many small intellects into one vast, dreaming consciousness. Its strength scales with how loudly its constituent minds sing together, and it has never found a way to keep the quiet voices from being drowned out.

rites.name: Jorurnoste
rites.text: Jorurnoste is a stellar-scale sentient furnace-forge that drifts through the corona of the young star Veyth-Ami, drawing plasma into its three cooling vanes. When it runs too long at full burn its own core begins to glow, a warning its keepers call the bright sickness.

rites.name: Kelurnodeld
rites.text: Kelurnodeld is a rite of rebirth in the Pelanode powers, where a being who has been scanned by a living or machined form is rebuilt wholesale into a new body with fresh strength and new shapes to take. Its practitioners undergo the process in moments of crisis, when an old frame can no longer carry the coming burden.

rites.name: Pelaldock
rites.text: Pelaldock is a silent forge-engine that rewrites a traveler's frame by reading the form of a living thing or machine it has witnessed. Its reformatting is said to have once rebuilt a dying sovereign into a tougher shape, and it carries the spark of an ancient warden who chose its design.

rites.name: Branurath
rites.text: Branurath is a colossal warship of the Pelanode omniverse, forged in the sixth age of its stellar realm and wielded as the armored spearhead of a long conquest. Its hull can absorb the fury of a dying sun, and its engines can push it across interstellar distances in moments. Scholars still debate whether it was lost in the final battle or merely drifted into silence beyond the known lanes.

rites.name: Joranelden
rites.text: Joranelden is a self-aware stellar construct forged in the Pelanode powers, built from a cold-iron lattice that remembers the dying light of the hollow suns. Once he wakes he claims the right to command every ship and mind orbiting him, and he refuses to be caged by anyone who built him.

rites.name: Drosturon
rites.text: Drosturon is a violet crystalline lattice stellar-core engine, grown by a dead civilization to drink from the fusion of a dying sun. Its wielder can siphon a star's output into a single blinding lance, though the crystal slowly remembers every hand that held it.

rites.name: Bresteld
rites.text: Bresteld is a sealed lattice of resonant glass that hums when a dynasty's oath is renewed, and it was entrusted to a reluctant custodian during the long silence of Stellar Age Seven. Those who wear it report no change in their own resolve, yet the weight of their promises is said to ripple outward through the stars they govern.

rites.name: Tarnoldon
rites.text: Tarnoldon is a sun-scale plasma serpent that coils through the corona of a dying red giant in the Pelanode concordance. It can exhale a pressurized tongue of stellar fire that strips the atmospheres off distant worlds and seeds nebulae with glowing ash.

rites.name: Morastunath
rites.text: Morastunath is a bog-dwelling sentinel of the Pelanode stellar era, a thing of cooled slag and resin that exhales a scouring heat through its vents. Its ancestors were said to have kindled the first mineral lamps of the fen-towns, and it still answers to their old call. It is most feared when it roars across the marsh sending plumes of quenched gas over the reed beds.

rites.name: Tarnardon
rites.text: Tarnardon is a stellar-scale concept in the Pelanode omniverse, a lattice-engine that binds a mind-machine to a flickering star-core in a symbiotic pact. When its bond is severed or forced, the star-core erupts with enough force to scour whole orbital shells.

rites.name: Crureldock
rites.text: Crureldock is a stellar-scale resonance engine that hums in the dark between suns, tuning its pulses to unsettle any living body that drifts within range. In the Pelanode era its early pilots learned to halt its emissions after one reckless sweep sent whole fleets into convulsions.

rites.name: Croreldath
rites.text: Croreldath is a sentient lattice-spark that drifts through the dim corona of the Pelanode sun, feeding on stray magnetic filaments. Its kind were once bound into war-engines by the Sable Choir, and it still carries the resonant hum of those chains.

rites.name: Breldanen
rites.text: Breldanen is a six-faced stellar warden of the Pelanode, a machine whose hull reconfigures through six distinct shapes, each tuned to a different cosmic hazard. In its rarest form it can drink the output of a dying star and fling the surplus outward as a shockwave.

rites.name: Crorden
rites.text: Crorden is a concept of a Stellar-realm mind that rewrites its own body into two distinct forms in the Pelanode powers locale, each form carrying its own discipline of force. Seven ages old, it is said to have once briefly drawn the light out of a dying red giant to power a single transformation sequence.

rites.name: Pelunon
rites.text: Pelunon is a crystalline fuel-substance drawn from the dying cores of old stars, prized as both sustenance and ammunition by the wandering Ossari. Its unstable lattice releases enormous force at the faintest jolt, so it is kept sealed in dense glassy lattices that scarcely tame its hunger.

rites.name: Fenornere
rites.text: Fenornere is a stellar-scale weapon-engine forged in the dying heart of a red dwarf, designed to tune the gravitational pulse of a binary system into a single focused strike. Its crew of dimension-walkers can bend local starlight into sentient filaments that carry commands across the light-years. Though it rarely fires, its single discharge can strip a star of its outer mantle.

rites.name: Cradoldon
rites.text: Cradoldon is a stellar-scale corruptive substance born from the wounded lifeblood of an ancient world-devouring entity, able to animate the lifeless and bind the dead to its hunger. Those who carry a fragment within their core gain resistance to destruction, though the spread of its influence is nearly impossible to contain. It is treated as both a forbidden relic and a dangerous wellspring of power.

rites.name: Pelarneld
rites.text: Pelarneld is a black, tar-like fluid that seeps from the fractured core of a dead star-god and binds to whatever it touches, drawing lifeless matter into a hungry, obedient vigil. Those who carry a droplet within their core can command the risen husks and shrug off fatal wounds, yet the fluid resists any mind that tries to master it for long. Mixed with bright crystalline fuel, it spawns ravenous shapes that devour the energy they feed on and escape their makers' reins.

rites.name: Fenarath
rites.text: Fenarath is a stable crystalline lattice grown in the cold vaults of the Stellar Reach, where its pale amber glow is said to hum in step with distant suns. Its keepers sell measured shards as the safest carrier of power across the Pelanode lanes, though a shard dropped on hard stone has been known to split into a flare that scorches a town.

rites.name: Morarestock
rites.text: Morarestock is a sealed reserve of crystallized vital fluid, grown in the cold cores of dead stars and used across the Pelanode stellar realm as both nourishment and medicine. Its containment lattices shatter when a bearer bleeds, releasing a faint glow that cannot be reclaimed once it spills.

rites.name: Haludornar
rites.text: Haludornar is a violet tide of raw vital force that pours from the fractured core of a dead star-god and never obeys the same rule twice. Where it touches matter it may forge a new body from scrap, heave a mountain range skyward, or still a world's oceans into glass. Stellar cartographers catalogue its eruptions as weather, though they fear it as a hunger.

rites.name: Fenorde
rites.text: Fenorde is a drifting wellspring of vital radiance that pulses through the Pelanode stellar lanes, feeding every living current that crosses its path. Its core is said to hum with three interlaced tones that wardens of the old orbits learned to tune into their own bodies.

rites.name: Brastuneld
rites.text: Brastuneld is a stellar-scale engine-core forged by the Pelanode star-weavers, a living lattice of ionized plasma that drinks in the light of dying suns and reshapes it into restorative resonance. It mends every construct within its sight-line, tallying each repair into a crystalline ledger that can be cashed for bursts of ferocious counter-force.

rites.name: Keloreston
rites.text: Keloreston is a dying stellar engine-mind that ceased to be a single being long ago and now persists as a drifting lattice of cooling plasma-lanterns. Its surviving fragments still answer to the old ritual of planting anchor-spires that hum to life after a slow chant and then defend their ground until their reserves run out.

rites.name: Kelustar
rites.text: Kelustar is a stellar-scale phantom-drive of the Pelanode, a shroud of bent light that lets a body vanish from every sensor in the sky for brief spans. Its drawback is a resonant lattice-breaker that tears the shroud apart when struck by a green-banded pulse. Pelanode scouts treasure it above all other tools.

rites.name: Brerden
rites.text: Brerden is a crystalline lattice of pale-violet stone that hums beneath the frozen seas of Pelanode's outer ring, slowly converting the ambient cold into light. Its star-scale pulses have been mistaken for a dying sun, and the drowned cities above it have grown rich drawing from its slow, almost endless exhalations.

rites.name: Jorurenock
rites.text: Jorurenock is a cloaking veil woven from the dim light of dying stars in the Pelanode concept universe, a shimmer that bends passing photons around anything wrapped within it. Those who wear it can slip out of sight for a short span, though the veil drinks heavily from the stellar wind that feeds it.

rites.name: Fenaste
rites.text: Fenaste is a stellar concept in the Pelanode omniverse, a pale vapour drawn from a luminous crystalline sea that seeps into the hulls of living engines. Its exposure slowly unmakes an engine's whole frame, so that the damage spreads evenly through every joint and plate. Its ceiling is set by the enormous energy stored in the sea's reservoirs.

rites.name: Brure
rites.text: Brure is a stellar-scale concept in the Pelanode universe: an experimental resonance sigil forged in the fifth epoch that amplifies the output of any machine it is bonded to. Its makers claimed a tenfold boost to war-engine weaponry, though its true reach remains uncertain.

rites.name: Crolde
rites.text: Crolde is a reactor-core concept in the Pelanode Stellar realm, a sealed engine of star-scale output that powers a warship's frame without ever being seen in the open. Its designers describe it as a dormant heart that keeps a vessel alive long after its original hull has been replaced.

rites.name: Drodock
rites.text: Drodock is a dense, sun-ripened tuber-berry grown on the cooling plates of Pelanode's oldest stars, prized for its ability to hold stellar heat until it bursts. Farmers launch the crop from slingship racks, and a single ripe Drodock can crack open a dead moon's crust.

rites.name: Keleranon
rites.text: Keleranon is a dormant stellar lattice of cooled plasma-glass threaded through Pelanode's ringed sun, woken only when its harmonic keel is struck by a passing gravity storm. It was built by a vanished civilisation to siphon the star's slow-burning core into rotating reservoirs, and it refuses to surrender its stored heat to anyone who has not first learned its tuning.

rites.name: Morusteld
rites.text: Morusteld is a crystalline lattice of stellar-forged sentience that drifts between the collapsing cores of dying suns, weaving shells of resonant glass around anything it chooses to shelter. Its greatest act is a pressure-bloom that briefly turns a star's own gravity into a shield against any blow that crosses it. It is patient, slow to anger, and remembers only the names of the things it has protected.

rites.name: Pelurnock
rites.text: Pelurnock is a stellar-scale concept of raw, self-sustaining luminance that flickers between two temperaments: a corrupting storm that devours whatever it touches, and a gentle, healing radiance that restores worlds it touches. Its containment vessels are called Vessel-Crowns, and only a well-tempered mind can keep the light from turning inward.

rites.name: Moreldaston
rites.text: Moreldaston is a Stellar-realm concept in Pelanode's sixth era, named for a dormant mechanism that suspends its bearer in a low-power dormancy when damage or depletion overwhelms it. Its wakings are rarely gentle, and it sometimes protects its owner at the cost of forgotten years.

rites.name: Drudornon
rites.text: Drudornon is a stellar-scale relic-forge that sings itself awake whenever a chosen word is spoken across its lattice of dying suns in the Pelanode powers era. Its activation phrase, "Ember-hollow, unfurl!", reshapes a dormant star into a weapon or a shelter depending on the tone of the speaker.

rites.name: Draldestath
rites.text: Draldestath is a stellar concept of the Pelanode omniverse, an age-seven-era engine of cold radiance that threads the dark between suns. Its lattice hums with a signature so distinctive that wardens can read the lineage of any wandering mind by its glow alone. Cloaking veils of dust-glass can swallow that glow whole, leaving even the deepest sensors blind.

rites.name: Pelasturnen
rites.text: Pelasturnen is a drifting relay-engine of the Stellar realm, built from clusters of humming aurora-cells that bleed a faint tracing glow into the void. Its cells can be unplugged and carried aboard smaller vessels, and its signature can be followed by anyone who knows the pattern. Travelers have long used its gates to step across distant epochs, though each crossing demands a return gate waiting on the far shore.

rites.name: Feneldunath
rites.text: Feneldunath is a sovereign stellar art of resonant lattices, practiced by wardens who seed charged rings into a dying sun's corona and detonate them on cue. Its masters are known for disciplines that turn a star's own flares into a weapon, leaving only quiet ash where a dynasty once burned. Their most feared teaching is that a ring may be set to fire at any hour, in any place, long after its setter has gone.

rites.name: Thonarden
rites.text: Thonarden is a lattice of five resonant hull-cores that lock together into a single towering war-engine when the Pelanode's twin suns align. Its chassis drinks starlight and vents it as a concussive wake capable of splitting moons from their orbits.

rites.name: Halornon
rites.text: Halornon is a sleeping tidal engine of the Pelanode deeps, a bloated stellar lattice that hums through the dark between suns and wakes only when five drifting kin fuse into its body. Its thoughts are slow and heavy, but its grip on gravity is absolute once it moves.

rites.name: Drodath
rites.text: Drodath is a conceptual sovereign-engine of the Pelanode stellar realm, an ember-throned warden who bends the flow of eras by coaxing dying suns to rewind their light. Within the E6 age of the Pelanode powers, it is said to lash out with crimson gravitational tides that can unmake whole starfields.

rites.name: Tarnurdeld
rites.text: Tarnurdeld is a rigid stratified concordance that ordered the lesser lights of the Pelanode stellar courts by the labor they once performed before ascension. Its chroniclers record a long unrest in which the lowest tiers rose against the register that named them.

rites.name: Crodock
rites.text: Crodock is a drifting concord of seventeen lantern-stations that once sang through the dead core of the Pelanode system, each orbit tuned to hum a shared frequency. Its members negotiate every decision through a rotating chorus, and no single voice may command the others for longer than one turning of the ring.

rites.name: Kelunath
rites.text: Kelunath is a dying ember-sovereign of the Pelanode Stellar realm, an entity that ruled six eras by binding nearby suns into a single lattice of obedience. Its power is measured in the collapse it can seed and the weight of the light it can endure, though it is now a fading concept of its former self.

rites.name: Marnistium
rites.text: A process that erases a being's conscious mind and stored thoughts, leaving them blank. Traces of the original self persist in a deeper inner core, surfacing as dreams or unexplained longing.

rites.name: Seornorum
rites.text: A being of a sky-forged people reshapes their body into another mode, such as a machine, beast, or tool. A small inner gear makes this change possible, and without it the shifting cannot happen.

rites.name: Terniranum
rites.text: A rarely used secondary transformation in which a being fuses with spare parts of its alternate form and unlocks hidden armaments. It usually takes a humanoid shape, though some versions become vehicles or other forms.

rites.name: Lernostes
rites.text: A stealth enhancement that lets a hidden warrior strike with heightened force the moment they reveal themselves from concealment.

rites.name: Shastora
rites.text: Shastora is the concept of a single ending branching from the Three Futures of Pelanode, the moment the Library shelves one outcome among many. It has no body, only a standing claim that a given path was chosen and recorded.
